decisions.reason: Exposing AXP2101 PWROK and VBACKUP does not change the ESP32 local-decoupling configuration or placement limit.
The source adds signal-only access to auxiliary AXP2101 pins and does not change AXP2101 or MT3608 decoupling-capacitor placement.
Adding two test pads or vias within the integrated design does not alter the single-board architecture or functional-consolidation requirement.
The AXP2101 auxiliary-pin exposure does not change the display-backlight circuit, supply selection, switching, or control behavior.
The source explicitly specifies signal traces rather than power traces, so it does not change the high-current VBUS, +5V, or BAT- routing requirement.
The requested AXP2101 test pads or vias do not affect the ESP32 breakout header or its 1.27 mm pitch.
Small pads or vias beside the AXP2101 do not necessarily alter any established connector, enclosure, orientation, or antenna-clearance constraint.
The source concerns auxiliary pins on the integrated board, not the separate power-board AXP2101 topology, VMID/VSYS connection, or thermal pad.
Exposing PWROK and VBACKUP preserves the selected AXP2101 power-management architecture and does not change its required rails or charging behavior.
PWROK debugging access and optional future VBACKUP use do not change current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of the INA device.
The AXP2101 auxiliary-pin change does not affect the dedicated I2C JST connector for the display light sensor.
Test pads or vias are not connectors, and the source does not change the through-hole assembly requirement for connectors.
